subject: Unable to log in
description: Forgot password and cannot access account
solution: Reset the password using the account recovery process.

subject: Password reset email not received
description: I tried forgot password but no email arrived
solution: Check the spam folder and request a new password reset email for the registered address.

subject: Payment was declined
description: My card payment fails at checkout
solution: Verify the billing details and contact the card issuer if the payment continues to be declined.

subject: Charged twice for my order
description: I see two charges for one purchase
solution: Share the order details with support so the duplicate charge can be reviewed.

subject: Where is my order
description: My shipment is late and tracking has not updated
solution: Check the order tracking page for the latest shipment status.

subject: Package delivered but missing
description: Tracking says delivered but I cannot find the package
solution: Check nearby delivery locations and contact support with your order number if it remains missing.

subject: App crashes on launch
description: The mobile application closes as soon as I open it
solution: Restart the app and device, then install the latest available app update.

subject: Cannot upload a document
description: File upload stops and shows an error
solution: Confirm the file meets the supported format and size limits, then try uploading again.

subject: Change shipping address
description: I entered the wrong delivery address for my order
solution: Contact support promptly with the order number to check whether the shipping address can still be updated.

subject: Cancel my subscription
description: I want to stop the next subscription renewal
solution: Open subscription settings and follow the cancellation steps shown there.

subject: Refund status
description: I returned an item and want to know when the refund arrives
solution: Check the refund status in your order details or contact support with the order number.

subject: Account locked
description: Too many login attempts locked my account
solution: Use the account recovery process or contact support to regain access to the locked account.
